text: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
Water does not boil at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level on Earth.
Mount Everest is not the highest mountain above sea level on Earth.
Penicillin was discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928.
Penicillin was not discovered by Alexander Fleming; it was first found in 1960.
The Pacific is the largest ocean on Earth.
The Atlantic, not the Pacific, is the largest ocean on Earth.
Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes.
Humans have 30 pairs of chromosomes.
The Berlin Wall fell in November 1989.
The Berlin Wall stood until 1995 and did not fall in 1989.
Light from the Sun takes about eight minutes to reach Earth.
Light from the Sun reaches Earth instantly, with no delay at all.
Antibiotics do not work against viral infections such as the common cold.
Antibiotics cure viral infections such as the common cold.
Canberra is the capital city of Australia.
Sydney is the capital city of Australia.
The human heart has four chambers.
The human heart has only two chambers.
The first Moon landing took place in July 1969.
Nobody landed on the Moon before 1980.
Diamonds are made of carbon.
Diamonds are made of silicon, not carbon.
Vaccines do not cause autism, according to large studies.
Large studies show that vaccines cause autism.
The Amazon River flows into the Atlantic Ocean.
The Amazon River flows into the Pacific Ocean.
Venus is the hottest planet in the Solar System.
Mercury is the hottest planet in the Solar System.
Drinking enough water helps prevent kidney stones.
Staying well hydrated lowers your chances of getting kidney stones.
We only use ten percent of our brains.
Ninety percent of the human brain sits unused.
Smoking is a leading cause of lung cancer.
Most cases of lung cancer are linked to cigarette smoking.
Goldfish have a memory span of only three seconds.
A goldfish forgets everything after about three seconds.
The Great Pyramid of Giza was built more than 4,000 years ago.
Egypt's Great Pyramid at Giza is over four millennia old.
Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
A spot that has been hit by lightning cannot be hit again.
Regular physical activity lowers the risk of type 2 diabetes.
People who exercise regularly are less likely to develop type 2 diabetes.
Bats are blind.
Bats cannot see at all and rely only on sound.
Honey can stay edible for a very long time if it is sealed.
Sealed honey keeps for years without spoiling.
Sugar makes children hyperactive.
Eating sweets causes hyperactivity in kids.
The Earth orbits the Sun once roughly every 365 days.
One trip of our planet around the Sun takes about a year.
Cracking your knuckles causes arthritis.
Popping your knuckles will give you arthritis in your hands.
Mosquitoes spread malaria.
Malaria is passed to people through mosquito bites.
Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short, at about five feet tall.
Napoleon stood only around five feet, far shorter than men of his time.
Sleep deprivation impairs memory and concentration.
Not getting enough sleep makes it harder to focus and remember things.
